title: Xevious (Classic NES)
sources: own knowledge of the NES original

rows: Blaster bomb (ground targets, at the crosshair)

widgets.text: Air and ground enemies need different weapons: zapper for flyers, blaster for tanks, domes and turrets.
The mothership: blast its core (the reactor in the middle) with the bomb while dodging its turrets.
16 areas of forest, desert, roads and Nazca-style lines; the game loops after area 16. The mothership Andor Genesis appears in several areas.
Bombing certain empty spots reveals hidden Sol citadels for bonus points, and special flags give an extra life.

Hidden Sol towers rise out of the ground when you bomb their spot: 2,000 points each. A few areas also hide a special flag worth an extra life. Bomb the ground in open stretches while the crosshair flashes red over nothing visible.
Survive to the next area; dying sends you back to the area's checkpoint.
